run_navigation_service: run the Pyro4 navigation server that registers the Navigation object on the daemon
create_Navigation_go_to_absolute: create a Navigation instance and call go_to_absolute to move the robot to a goal position
create_Navigation_go_to_object: create a Navigation instance and call go_to_object to navigate the robot toward a COCO category object
create_Navigation_execute_low_level_comm: create a Navigation instance and call execute_low_level_command to move forward, turn, or tilt the robot
review_Trackback_get_loc: review the Trackback class get_loc method that finds the nearest reachable location from a set of tracked positions
